authority: Worker measurement only. Issues no schema verdict, no node status, no validation_status, no gate verdict. Read-only on every canonical path; writes only under artifacts/worker-044/gform_accept_scope/ and runtime/state/.
question: The live G-FORM coverage measurement counts 'effective independent full-schema accept clusters' per class (worker-087 W087-GFORM-INDEP-04/r2, summary.json sha256 c12aa690c619, accepts_current F1=6 / F2a=3 / F2b=1). Does each counted accept record DECLARE full-schema coverage, or does it declare a restricted scope (axis / repair / delta / record-level) that the counted-set harvest did not read? Recount each class under a pre-registered scope rule and report the corrected accept sets.
why_now: The gate criterion recorded by REC-23 is 'F2b to reach >=2 accepts at one stable hash' and reviewers themselves use the qualifier 'blind full-schema accept' (worker-073, worker-061). A scoped accept counted as full-schema changes the gate arithmetic. worker-087's own falsifier invites re-measurement of the criterion-met findings.

amendments.A1_negation_guard: Made after the pilot run (pilot_report.json sha256 2c068fdf97c1d4adced2d61b308c2056b037f7edee24253b7a35530c25a03b48) and before the final run. The pilot classified worker-011's F1 accept as FULL_EXPLICIT although its own text says 'NOT a full-schema verdict, NOT a gate verdict'. The final rule (i) adds the limitation pattern 'not a full-schema verdict', (ii) discards a full-schema pattern match whose preceding 24 characters contain a negation cue (not|never|no|cannot), and (iii) adds control K9 for this exact negation. The pilot classification of the F2b clusters (worker-061 SCOPED) is unchanged by the amendment.
amendments.A2_non_schema_meta: Made before the final run. A record whose verdict is accept but whose own counts_as_full_schema_verdict is explicitly false and whose curated text has no positive full-schema marker is classified NON_SCHEMA_META and excluded from both the strict and the permissive count (control K10). worker-082's 01:08:30 F1/F2a records ('A1 cross-target independence census') are the motivating case: they accept a census finding, not the schema.
amendments.A3_off_gate: Made before the final run. A record that declares a `gate` value other than G-FORM is classified NON_SCHEMA_META and excluded from the G-FORM counts even if its target hash binds the class pin (control K11). Motivating case: worker-16's 01:07:36 F2b accept carries gate=G-AUDIT and counts_as_independent_second_verdict=false; it is a G-AUDIT convergence-checklist closure, not a G-FORM schema verdict.
amendments.A4_posthoc_secondary: Declared post-hoc, after the final run, as a separate section of report.json: the F2b strict accept count at the live pin is now >=2 (it was 0/1 earlier), so the report records for each strict accept whether its own text names the implication_ledger / forbidden_transfers / containment axis, and counts the independent revise/reject records at the same pin that do. This secondary observation does not change the pre-registered scope verdict.

harvest_rule.H1: A record is a candidate iff it is a review-typed record (channel A: a JSON object in reviews/*.json with a reviewer/actor and verdict; channel B: an event with event_type=review in comms/outbox/*.jsonl) with verdict normalized to accept.
harvest_rule.H2: Its primary hash is the first present of reviewed_sha256, artifact_sha256, target_sha256, reviewed_artifact_sha256, artifact_sha256_measured, reviewed_sha, artifact.hash.
harvest_rule.H3: It binds class C iff primary hash prefix (12 hex) == live pin prefix of C. Records whose primary hash binds a superseded revision are excluded and counted.
harvest_rule.H4: A record binds to exactly one class by the class id/node it names; if it names none, it is assigned by the pin it binds.
harvest_rule.H5: Deduplicate on (class, reviewer, primary_hash, verdict-normalized, record-channel-source).

scope_rule.S1_hard_limitation: The record's curated text fields match any of: /covers\s+ONLY/i, /not\s+the\s+full\s+schema/i, /remains\s+the\s+binding\s+coverage/i, /this\s+verdict\s+covers\b[^.;]{0,120}\b(only|excluding)\b/i, /scope\s*[:=][^.;]{0,80}\bonly\b/i, /\bexcludes\s*:/i.
scope_rule.S2_explicit_full: The record declares counts_as_full_schema_verdict=true, or its curated text matches /full[- ]schema\s+(verdict|review|accept)/i or /\bG-FORM\s+verdict\b/i or /all\s+\d+\s+conformance\s+checks\s+PASS/i.
scope_rule.S3_classification: SCOPED if S1 matches and S2 does not; FULL_EXPLICIT if S2 matches and S1 does not; SCOPED_AND_FULL if both; FULL_IMPLIED otherwise (accept bound to the schema pin with no scope text).
scope_rule.S4_reviewer_cluster: Per (class, reviewer): SCOPED if at least one harvested record is SCOPED and none is FULL_EXPLICIT; FULL_EXPLICIT if at least one record is FULL_EXPLICIT and none is SCOPED; FULL_IMPLIED if all records are FULL_IMPLIED; SCOPED_AND_FULL if both appear.

S5_counts.permissive_count: distinct reviewers whose cluster is FULL_EXPLICIT, FULL_IMPLIED or SCOPED_AND_FULL (i.e. not disqualified by a hard scope limitation).
S5_counts.strict_count: distinct reviewers whose cluster is FULL_EXPLICIT.
S5_counts.criterion: G-FORM as recorded: >=2 distinct independent full-schema accepts per class at one stable hash.

scope_rule.S6_non_scope_disclaimers: Standard epistemic disclaimers ('no gate verdict', 'no mathematics verdict', 'advisory', 'declarative scope only; no mathematics/citation verdict', 'mechanical checks only') are NOT hard limitations unless they also restrict the reviewed surface; the rule above is applied literally and every match is reported verbatim for audit.

controls_planned.K1: synthetic full-schema accept (counts_as_full_schema_verdict=true, no limitation) -> FULL_EXPLICIT
controls_planned.K2: synthetic scoped accept copied from the worker-061 pattern -> SCOPED, disqualified
controls_planned.K3: synthetic accept bound to a stale hash -> not harvested
controls_planned.K4: synthetic accept for the other class pin -> not harvested for this class
controls_planned.K5: synthetic accept with counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false and no text -> FULL_IMPLIED, counted permissive, not strict
controls_planned.K6: two distinct FULL_EXPLICIT reviewers -> criterion_met true
controls_planned.K8: non-review event carrying the word accept -> not harvested

decision_rule: Report corrected per-class counts under both rules. A class meets the recorded criterion iff strict_count >= 2. If a counted cluster is SCOPED, report its disqualifying text verbatim and name the gate arithmetic consequence. If no counted cluster is SCOPED, report NO_SCOPE_DEFECT.
falsifier: Falsified if (a) any record classified SCOPED is shown to declare full-schema coverage elsewhere in its own record (quote the field), or any record classified FULL_IMPLIED/SCOPED_AND_FULL is shown to declare a hard coverage limitation that the rule missed; (b) any live class pin differs from the recorded pin at end of run (drift voids live applicability, not the snapshot measurement); (c) a control K1-K8 fails to classify as pre-registered; (d) re-running scope_audit.py on the same snapshot yields a different verdict_digest; (e) a hash-bound accept at a live pin from a reviewer not in the harvested set is shown to exist in either channel.
non_claims: Does not adjudicate worker-087's independence or dedup axes, only the scope axis.
Detector churn is recorded as context, not adjudicated.
